scope: Development evaluation of a prospectively specified learner-seed replication. DS/SS/DD and final-checkpoint selection were recorded before seeds 3–9 training; this runner and interval details were specified after training and before full-development results for the new cohort. Not a final test.
comparisons: PA minus P paired by learner seed for each mode

intervals.metric: mean destruction difference in percentage points
intervals.interpretation: Conditional on the fixed development layouts and acting-seed labels. Resample independent learner pairs, not attack rows. Screening n=3 intervals omitted; all n=10 includes the development-selection cohort. Descriptive, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

rng: Reuse version2.evaluation.episode_seed. Reset Python, NumPy and Torch RNGs once per attack; no reseed at the purchasing/deployment boundary.
training: No training or model mutation. Original simulator including movement remains unchanged.
final_pool: No final-pool access; a separate held-out protocol is required.
